1D03 reference & how this works

Orientation budgets

Tutorial TA1: 65h (12 teaching, 25 consultation/lectures, 17 grading, 5 preparation, 6 invigilation). Lab TA1: 65h (30 teaching, 15 grading, 15 preparation, 5 other).

Choose your assigned role when starting. You track one assignment at a time; use Manage to change its appointment. Templates also include Tutorial TA2 and Lab TA2–TA4. These are estimates; your signed Hours of Work form takes precedence.

For Lab roles, the combined midterm marking/invigilation budget is under Other. Record an activity description to retain the detail. Shared work counts once: choose the assignment it belongs to, or divide the time between assignments.

Record what you worked

Log teaching, lecture attendance, preparation, training, emails, marking, meetings, invigilation, and make-up labs. Budgets never create worked entries automatically.

Tutorial sessions are budgeted at 2h; labs at 3h. The lab schedule lists 8:30–11:20 and 14:30–17:20 (2h 50m). Record actual time, including any real setup or wrap-up. Lecture attendance is budgeted at 1h; confirm the assigned schedule rather than assuming a weekly count.

Time entries use local wall-clock minutes, with explicit end dates for overnight work. Split work at midnight for accurate daily reports. For clock changes, use duration mode with actual elapsed minutes.

Your data stays with you

No account, analytics, or work-data server. Records stay in this browser on this device. Other users have their own empty tracker.

Export backups regularly. Clearing website data, private browsing, device loss, or changing the website address can remove access to records. Export/import moves a complete copy between devices; there is no automatic sync.

On iPhone/iPad use Safari’s Share → Add to Home Screen. On Android or desktop, use the browser’s install option when available. Offline use becomes available after a successful first load.

Keep a copy of your work.

JSON backups preserve assignments and entries. CSV is for reports.

TA Hours · Independent, open-source tool · No affiliation with McMaster University

Log work

The timer keeps running if you close the app. Stop & save records the worked time automatically, rounded to the nearest minute (minimum 1 minute). Stop for breaks.

Assignment settings

Choose one role for this course: Tutorial TA or Lab TA. Double Lab TA (TA3) has a 130-hour budget with its own duty breakdown. Changing a template updates budgets, never worked entries.
